title: The Inner Flame
about: The first game: a tall, scared robot types his way across four planets, solves riddles, and makes friends (a magic puppy, a penguin, and a mossy rock) on the way to the flame that relights his world. Kept as one legacy file; its characters, music style, and question ideas live on in the library as Starward's modules.

tagline: One scared robot. Zero friends... so far!
Solve riddles, meet a magic puppy, and find the flame to relight his world.

releases.notes: Original game, designed by Child I by voice.
